profile.name: Ed Lopez
profile.title: Customer Success / Operations Analyst
profile.summary: Customer-focused professional with experience translating business needs into clear processes, documentation, and practical solutions. Strong ability to learn tools quickly, organize information, and communicate across teams.

bullets: Improved daily tracking workflows by organizing recurring tasks, notes, and follow-up actions into repeatable checklists.
Supported internal teams by documenting process steps and clarifying requirements for common operational requests.
Used spreadsheet tools to review information, reduce manual errors, and prepare concise updates for stakeholders.
Handled customer inquiries with a focus on clear communication, empathy, and timely resolution.
Maintained accurate records and escalated complex cases with complete context for faster follow-up.
Identified repeated issues and shared improvement ideas with the team.
